answer: CCEE 543 Mobile Communications, 3(3,0): evolution of cellular technologies from 2G to LTE - medium access, GSM architecture and planning, handover, 3G architecture and procedures, and introduction to 4G/LTE. Co-requisite: CCEE 449.

source_quote: CCEE 562 Artificial Intelligence 3(3,0)
answer: CCEE 562 Artificial Intelligence, 3(3,0): knowledge representation and learning in AI, intelligent agents, informed/uninformed and adversarial search. Prerequisite: CCEE 214 or equivalent.

answer: CCEE 564 Machine Learning and Data Mining, 3(3,0): knowledge representation and learning, the data mining process, classification, prediction and clustering; equivalent to COSC 480. The description lists CCEE 214 as prerequisite.
review_note: The CCE mandatory table and study plan list CCEE 214 and MATH 351 or BADM 250; the description lists only CCEE 214.

answer: CCEE 457 Cybersecurity Fundamentals, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: introductory cybersecurity concepts and practical skills, threat reduction, defense strategies and post-incident forensics. Prerequisite: CCEE 354.

answer: CCEE 498 Special Topics in Computer & Communication Engineering, 3(3,0): current special topics selected by the instructor and department.

source_quote: to build mobile apps for Android and iOS, two of today’s most popular platforms, and
answer: CCEE 511 Mobile Application Development, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: building and deploying native Android and iOS apps (Android SDK, Xcode/iOS SDK) and web apps. Prerequisite: CCEE 214; equivalent to COSC 435.

source_quote: This course covers operating systems principles; scheduling and resource
answer: CCEE 513 Operating Systems, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: OS principles, scheduling, virtual memory, file systems, concurrency, security, network and distributed OS, with a UNIX case study. Prerequisite: CCEE 214; equivalent to COSC 451.

source_quote: XML and web services. Prerequisite: CCEE 411/COSC 333. Equivalent to COSC 434.
answer: CCEE 514 Advanced Web Programming, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: server-side programming, database connectivity, web and validation controls, data binding, state management, XML and web services. Prerequisite: CCEE 411 or COSC 333; equivalent to COSC 434.

source_quote: distributed applications, including testing, debugging, and performance evaluation. The
answer: CCEE 515 Distributed Computing, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: building parallel and distributed applications - testing, debugging, performance evaluation, paradigms, architectures and languages. Prerequisite: CCEE 528 or equivalent.

source_quote: This course introduces students to various aspects of parallel processing, including
answer: CCEE 520 Parallel Processing, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: parallel architectures, algorithms, systems and languages with hands-on parallel projects. Prerequisite: CCEE 221.

source_quote: This course introduces the student to the design of complex embedded systems.
answer: CCEE 521 Hardware-Software Co-Design, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: modeling hardware and software, partitioning, design space exploration, performance estimation and a co-design project. Prerequisite: CCEE 221.

source_quote: This course focuses on digital signal processing (DSP) and its applications. It helps
answer: CCEE 535 Digital Signal Processing, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: DSP tools, digital filter structures and design, DSP algorithm implementation and spectral analysis with MATLAB simulations. Prerequisite: CCEE 331.

source_quote: Two-dimensional signals and systems. Image formation and perception.
answer: CCEE 536 Digital Image Processing, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: 2-D signals and systems, image formation, coding, filtering, restoration, enhancement, feature extraction, computer vision and medical imaging intro. The description lists CCEE 331 or equivalent as prerequisite.
review_note: CCE elective table (p.328) lists CCEE 214 as prerequisite; description (p.341) lists CCEE 331 or equivalent.

source_quote: This course focuses on the fundamentals of satellite technology. Topics include the
answer: CCEE 540 Satellite Communication Systems, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: satellite history, missions, orbits, launch, link fundamentals, hardware, communication satellites, GPS and direct broadcast. Prerequisite: CCEE 447.

source_quote: This course introduces the fundamental principles of microwave circuit analysis and
answer: CCEE 542 Microwave Communications, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: transmission line theory, impedance matching, microwave network analysis, power dividers and propagation, with lab experiments. Prerequisite: ELEC 340.

source_quote: This course seeks to provide insight into the development of the latest generations of
answer: CCEE 545 Advanced Mobile Communications, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: LTE and LTE-Advanced architecture, air interface, radio procedures, QoS and planning, plus 5G and IoT. Co-requisite: CCEE 449.

source_quote: antenna benefits; beamforming techniques; adaptive antennas; MIMO systems:
answer: CCEE 546 Array Processing, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: multi-antenna concepts, beamforming, adaptive antennas, MIMO diversity/multiplexing, Alamouti and spatio-temporal techniques. The description lists CCEE 444 as prerequisite.
review_note: Elective table (p.328) lists CCEE 544 (not otherwise listed); description lists CCEE 444.

source_quote: This course is designed to progress from the description of the components in a fiber
answer: CCEE 547 Optical Communications, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: fiber link components (fiber, connections, sources, receivers) integrated into complete optical links. The description lists CCEE 331 as prerequisite.
review_note: Elective table (p.328) lists CCEE 447; description (p.342) lists CCEE 331.

source_quote: Network security is the protection of the underlying networking infrastructure from
answer: CCEE 552 Network Security, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: protecting networking infrastructure from unauthorized access, misuse or theft. Prerequisite: CCEE 354 or COSC 360.

source_quote: telephone systems (PDH/SDH, SONET), Frame Relay, ATM, and MPLS, as well as
answer: CCEE 553 Advanced Communication Networks, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: network architectures (PDH/SDH, SONET, Frame Relay, ATM, MPLS), performance assessment and QoS technologies. Prerequisite: CCEE 354.

source_quote: This Lab helps prepare students seeking to pass advanced Cisco Certifications (CCNA
answer: CCEE 554L Computer Networks Lab 2, 1(0,2): CCNA 1 preparation - network equipment, Ethernet networks, router CLI configuration and hands-on troubleshooting. Co-requisite: CCEE 354L.

source_quote: this course, we will explore TCP; Internet inter-domain routing; Internet quality of
answer: CCEE 555 Advanced Computer Networks, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: TCP, inter-domain routing, QoS and traffic engineering, traffic measurement, data centers, content distribution, SDN and socket programming. Prerequisite: CCEE 354.

source_quote: Essentials (CCNA 2) Certification. The primary focus of this Lab is routers and switches
answer: CCEE 555L Computer Networks Lab 3, 1(0,2): CCNA 2 preparation - routers and switches in small networks, static and dynamic routing, ACLs, VLANs, DHCP and NAT. Prerequisite: CCEE 354L.

source_quote: This course will help students become system administrators and install, configure,
answer: CCEE 556 Network and System Administration, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: installing and maintaining Windows Server and Linux, Active Directory, and preparation for the MCSA Windows Server exam. Prerequisite: CCEE 354.

answer: CCEE 556L Computer Networks Lab 4, 1(0,2): CCNA 3 preparation - advanced router/switch configuration, enhanced switching, first-hop redundancy, wireless and IOS licensing. Prerequisite: CCEE 555L.

source_quote: Introductory historical development of robotics; rigid-object kinematics; robot arm
answer: CCEE 563 Robotics, 3(3,0), a CCE technical elective: history of robotics, rigid-body and arm kinematics, inverse kinematics, dynamics, trajectory planning and manipulator control. Prerequisites: MATH 311 and MATH 314; equivalent to MECA 524.

answer: CCEE 597 Advanced Topics in Computer & Communications Engineering, 3(3,0): a selected advanced CCE topic defined by the instructor and approved by the department. Prerequisite: instructor's consent (elective table: Senior Standing).
